<title level="1" right="Spell 3" pfs="Standard">
[Veil of Privacy](/Spells.aspx?ID=1739)
<actions string="" />
</title>

<traits>
<trait label="Uncommon" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=159" />
<trait label="Concentrate" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=32" />
<trait label="Manipulate" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=104" />
</traits>

<column gap="tiny">

**Source** [Player Core](/Sources.aspx?ID=216) pg. 366

**Traditions**
[Arcane](/SpellLists.aspx?Tradition=1), [Occult](/SpellLists.aspx?Tradition=3), [Primal](/SpellLists.aspx?Tradition=4)

**Deities**
[Ahriman](/Deities.aspx?ID=220), [Erecura](/Deities.aspx?ID=151), [Lao Shu Po](/Deities.aspx?ID=312), [Nocticula](/Deities.aspx?ID=45)

<row gap="medium">

**Cast** 10 minutes

 

</row>

<row gap="medium">
**Range** touch

**Target** 1 creature or object
</row>

<row gap="medium">

**Duration** 8 hours
</row>

</column>

---

You erect protective wards that make the target difficult to detect via magic. _Veil of privacy_ attempts to [counteract](/Rules.aspx?ID=371) all [detection](/Traits.aspx?ID=43), [revelation](/Traits.aspx?ID=138), and [scrying](/Traits.aspx?ID=141) effects used against the target or the target's gear throughout the duration, counting cantrips as 1st-rank spells for this purpose. Successfully counteracting a spell that targets an area or multiple targets negates the effects for only _veil of privacy's_ target.
name: Veil of Privacy
